event_semantics: Coarse one-to-one delivery windows from one-second source-only left and right panel samples, frozen before reading predictions for this interval. These are observed stone travel intervals, not release timestamps.
reference_limitations: One-second sampling and split-screen views can miss a brief or hidden delivery; continuous full-frame source review has not independently verified completeness.
The same agent prepared this reference and develops the detector, so this is a source-first development check rather than independent validation.
The interval begins and ends during play; events crossing its boundaries could be truncated.
